joinQ1: Why should I join dekitabi Affiliate Program?
joinA1: dekitabi is a Japan-based startup company focused solely on Japan. In addition to having the best fees, we aim to offer a wide variety of options for our affiliates to stand out from the competition. We want to work closely with our affiliates to offer the best to travelers visiting Japan.
joinQ2: Who can join dekitabi Affiliate Program?
joinA2: Anyone can join our affiliate program. We welcome anyone who loves Japan and wants to share the beautiful areas of Japan, way beyond Tokyo, Osaka and Kyoto, with travelers.
joinQ3: How do I make money with dekitabi Affiliate Program?
joinA3: You can earn money with our affiliate program in two different ways. We will pay you a commission on tours (9%) that have been booked and completed through direct traffic coming from you. Or you can refer tour guides to join our website. They can use your coupon code generated at the moment they sign up and you will receive 5% of their completed tours' fee for their first 5 completed tours. Our service fees for guides are the best in the market.
joinQ4: Do I need a website to join dekitabi Affiliate Program?
joinA4: No. You can generate ¥1000 discount coupon codes that travelers can use at the checkout. With that code we will know travelers were referenced by you. Coupon codes will not affect your commission.
shareQ1: How can I share dekitabi's tours?
shareA1: It is very simple to share our tours with travelers. You just need to add ?affiliateId=YOUR_AFFILIATE_ID to the end of the url you want to share. Or you can offer travelers ¥1000 discount coupon codes to use at the checkout. Coupons will not affect your commission.
shareQ2: How can I introduce dekitabi to tour guides?
shareA2: You can generate a coupon code and share it with the tour guide to whom you wish to introduce dekitabi. At the time of registration, the tour guide can add the coupon code and we will know that it has been referenced by you.
shareQ3: Can I use dekitabi's content to my website?
shareA3: You can create and share dekitabi's itineraries, our attraction page with updated information, guide's profiles pages or anything you find best for promoting our website to your travelers.
paymentA1: Affiliates living in Japan will have their balance transferred to their bank account every Friday (Tokyo time). Affiliates living outside of Japan will have their balance via PayPal on the 1st and 15th of each month (if their balance is over ¥15,000). Contact us if you wish to receive your balance using a different method.
paymentQ2: Which currency will I receive my balance in?
paymentA2: Guide fees set by guides registered at dekitabi and the commissions are calculated in Japanese Yen. The payment will use the currency rate of the day.
paymentQ3: I live outside Japan, can I use something different than PayPal?
paymentA3: Yes, please contact our sales department and we will adjust to your needs.
